steps.en: Run the container with your public URL and a data volume
steps.zh: 跑起容器，传入对外网址并挂载数据卷

steps.en: Put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front (the web vault refuses to work without it)
steps.zh: 前面加一层 HTTPS 反向代理（没有它网页版密码库不工作）

steps.en: Serves the Bitwarden client API and a bundled web vault from one process
steps.zh: 一个进程同时提供 Bitwarden 客户端 API 和自带的网页版密码库

steps.en: Create accounts and point every official Bitwarden app at your domain
steps.zh: 注册账号，把每个官方 Bitwarden 应用指向你的域名

steps.en: Stores only the ciphertext the apps upload, and syncs it to all your devices
steps.zh: 只保存应用上传的密文，并同步到你所有设备

value.en: The official Bitwarden apps everywhere, with the server, the data and the organisation features on your own small box
value.zh: 各端都用官方 Bitwarden 应用，服务器、数据和组织功能都在你自己的小机器上

sources: https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden#usage (web vault requires HTTPS / secure context; reverse proxy recommended)
https://github.com/dani-garcia/vaultwarden#features (Bitwarden Client API, modified web vault bundled in containers)
